These settings decide whether the VPN keeps running while the app is in the background. Fix every amber item so the tunnel is not stopped.
Background is ready: the required system permissions are on
Almost ready: turn on Block connections without VPN so traffic cannot bypass the tunnel
Needs setup: the system can stop the VPN while the app is in the background
On: the VPN stopped alert will be shown
Off: VPN stop and security alerts are not shown
Exempt: sleep mode does not stop the VPN service
Not exempt: the VPN service often stops in the background. Tap Fix and choose Allow.
Not restricted
Restricted: the system will stop the VPN soon after you leave the app. Remove the restriction in App info, then Battery.
On: the system starts the VPN again by itself
Off: turn on always-on VPN for AIVPN in system VPN settings, the gear next to AIVPN
On: if the tunnel stops, the system does not let traffic bypass the VPN
Off: if the tunnel stops, traffic goes out directly. This system switch blocks that bypass.
This cannot be checked until the VPN service is running. Open the system VPN settings.
This manufacturer firmware may also require autostart or removing AIVPN from sleeping apps. That screen may not exist on this device.
Some devices also need AIVPN autostart in the manufacturer battery or security app.
Client created, but the exit node was not assigned. Select it in the client settings.
